text: E ɓen ɓe rewataa wonndude e Alla O Senike reweteeɗo goo, ɓe warataa wonkii ki Alla harmini warugol si wanaa kon ko Alla duŋini ɗum immorde e wartagol waruɗo maaɗum yartodinɗo maaɗum jeenoowo saŋiiɗo, hara ɓe jinataa, kala waɗuɗo ɗii bakkatuuji mawɗi ɗoo, o hawroyay Ñalnde Darngal e Lepte ko o waɗɗitii kon immorde e bakkaatu.
